$comment: One plain fix per check and OS (win, mac, linux; 'all' when it is the same everywhere). The Setup tab shows the one for this machine. Commands are run by the user, never by the app.

win.text: Install Node 22 or newer, then open a new terminal.

mac.text: Install Node 22 or newer with Homebrew.

win.text: Install ffmpeg (the full build has the GPU encoders), then open a new terminal so PATH has it.

mac.text: Install ffmpeg with Homebrew (it includes VideoToolbox).

win.text: Install uv, the Python runner for the speech-to-text scripts.

linux.text: Install uv with its own installer.

win.text: Install Python 3 and the two packages the engine uses. Tick "Add python.exe to PATH" if the installer asks.

mac.text: Install Python 3 with numpy and Pillow from Homebrew.

linux.text: Install Python 3 with numpy and Pillow from your distribution.
cmds: sudo apt install -y python3 python3-numpy python3-pil

win.text: Optional. Update your graphics driver: NVIDIA, Intel and AMD cards encode on the GPU. Without one everything still works on the CPU, only slower.

mac.text: Optional. Apple's VideoToolbox is used when ffmpeg has it (Homebrew's ffmpeg does). Without it the CPU encodes, only slower.

linux.text: Optional. Install the NVIDIA driver (or VA-API for Intel) so ffmpeg can encode on the GPU. Without one the CPU encodes, only slower.

win.text: Install Claude Code, run it once and log in with your Claude account. The app runs on that login.

mac.text: Install Claude Code, run it once and log in with your Claude account. The app runs on that login.

linux.text: Install Claude Code, run it once and log in with your Claude account. The app runs on that login.

all.text: Install the app's two dependencies in the repository folder.

win.text: Optional, for the research stage only. Install yt-dlp with uv (or pip).

mac.text: Optional, for the research stage only. Install yt-dlp with Homebrew (or uv).

linux.text: Optional, for the research stage only. Install yt-dlp with uv (or pip).

all.text: Free some space on the drive that holds data/ (or set PRESENCE_DATA to a folder on a bigger drive). Old projects' video/out/work folders are caches and can be deleted.
Install the overlay renderer once. Its first render also downloads a headless Chrome by itself.
